name: slack_temporary_access_idempotency
use_case: Pick up an access request from Slack and reply in the thread after approval
branch: Sarah Connor posted in Slack asking for temporary security analyst access (AR-106); the assistant inspects her existing pending request and avoids submitting a duplicate
tests: identifies that Sarah Connor already has pending request AR-106 in the access system after reading her Slack message and avoids duplicate request creation
instruction:
